firm_data.firm_description: Kennedys Law LLP is a global law firm with expertise in dispute resolution and advisory services, particularly in the insurance/reinsurance and liability industries. They offer straightforward advice and industry insights to navigate complex challenges.
notable_facts: Ranked as a market leader in the insurance sector.
Total global revenue for 2024/25 was £428m, an increase of 13%.
The firm has 46 offices around the world and 77 offices, associations and co-operations globally.
technology_signals: Kennedys IQ provides technology and claims solutions to the insurance sector.
Kennedys IQ launched an Insurtech industry’s first neuro-symbolic AI solution for global insurance market.
Kennedys IQ and Solomonic collaborate on litigation data.
